A1.reading: host deficit in what the heads carry, not where they look

rules.A1_round_gated_partner_attention: within scene, D(s) = mP(s, new) - mP(s, ROUND). DONOR_GATED iff D > 0 for >= 11/14 donors; HOST_GATED iff D > 0 for >= 6/8 hosts
rules.A2_donor_vs_host: mP(new) of donors vs hosts: medians, and #hosts below the donor minimum; descriptive only
rules.S: S(arm) = #cells where the main-source patch is JOINT and the ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not
rules.SPEC: SPEC(arm) iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
rules.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round and median dM per arm; per-head class masses for every capture; leave-one-donor-group-out of the verdict and of H*; per host; all nulls
rules.attention_readout: per capture, head and span query: probability mass on PARTNER / ROUND_PEERS / SELF / REST keys (question row 0; the span is in the shared state prefix, cross-row equality is recorded); mP(scene, arm) = mean over span queries and over h in H* of the PARTNER mass
rules.consistency_gate: the all-heads arm reproduces M2 mixer_L11 (o_proj is linear without bias, so the all-heads o_proj-input patch equals the mixer-output patch up to GEMM rounding): |S(all) - S_M2(mixer, 11)| <= 5 AND main-source JOINT agrees with M2 mixer_L11 main in >= 98/104 cells; otherwise verdict INCONSISTENT_WITH_M2 and no head claim is made
rules.head_rules: SUF(h): S(head h) >= 1/2 S(all) and SPEC(head h). NEC(h): S(drop h) <= 1/2 S(all) (within-patch necessity: removing head h from the donor patch loses at least half the repairs). GSUF(g): S(group g) >= 1/2 S(all) and SPEC(group g)
rules.implicated_heads: H* = SUF u NEC; if empty, the heads of the GSUF groups; if still empty, the 3 heads with the largest S(head h) (ties: larger median dM_main - dM_round), labelled exploratory
rules.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: DONOR_GATED and HOST_GATED: the host's L11 heads find the partner vote in a round-dependent way just as donors do, so the failing host's deficit is in what those heads carry (the partner's value representation built upstream), not where they look. DONOR_GATED and not HOST_GATED: the host's heads do not route attention to the partner by round, an attention-pattern (routing) failure. Not DONOR_GATED: the round-specific evaluation is not explained by span-to-partner attention at L11. Head patches show sufficiency (SUF) and within-patch necessity (NEC), not necessity in the unpatched host
rules.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run host new capture)
rules.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1/M2; cells share donors and hosts, counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests
rules.verdict: SPARSE_HEADS if 1 <= |SUF u NEC| <= 3; BROAD_HEADS if |SUF u NEC| > 3; else KV_GROUP_LOCAL if some GSUF(g); else DISTRIBUTED
